messages.text: Hey team, we need to decide on our notification strategy for the new dashboard. Should we go with email, push, or both?
I think push notifications make sense for urgent alerts and email for digests. We should probably support both.
Agreed on both. One question — do we have a preference for the notification library? I was looking at web-push vs Firebase.
Firebase is probably easier to set up and we already have a Google Cloud account.
I prefer web-push to avoid the Firebase dependency. It works with any VAPID-compatible server.
@Collaboration can you add a task to spike both options and compare implementation complexity?
While we're at it, we should also decide on the notification frequency settings — per-user preferences or global defaults?
Per-user for sure. We learned from the last release that global defaults frustrate power users.
@Collaboration what decisions have we made so far in this project?
Let's also make sure we capture the per-user preference decision as a formal decision item.
@Collaboration add an issue: we need to design the notification preferences schema before implementation can begin.
